annotation.evidence_span: SHOULD either reject connection attempts that use the same addresses as existing connections, or use a non-zero-length Destination Connection ID
annotation.interpretation_a: An endpoint MAY allow connection attempts that use the same addresses as existing connections, as long as it uses a non-zero-length Destination Connection ID.
annotation.interpretation_b: An endpoint MAY reject connection attempts that use the same addresses as existing connections, even if a non-zero-length Destination Connection ID is used.
annotation.justification: The use of SHOULD creates a choice between two behaviors. The clause does not specify what happens if an endpoint does neither reject the connection attempt nor use a non-zero-length Connection ID. This creates an incomplete constraint.
